root_cause.text: The `virtnet_info` structure placed a flexible-array member (`struct virtio_net_rss_config_trailer`) immediately before a fixed-size array `rss_hash_key_data`, and due to tail padding in the flexible-array struct, these two fields were misaligned by one byte, causing the RSS key data to be shifted (last byte truncated and an uninitialized byte prepended) when accessed.
root_cause.evidence: Commit message states: "Notice that due to tail padding in flexible `struct virtio_net_rss_config_trailer`, `rss_trailer.hash_key_data` (at offset 83 in struct virtnet_info) and `rss_hash_key_data` (at offset 84 in struct virtnet_info) are misaligned by one byte." and "As a result, the RSS key passed to the device is shifted by 1 byte: the last byte is cut off, and instead a (possibly uninitialized) byte is added at the beginning."
